review_text: Amazon has yet again shown its greedy side. I already had their subscription. now they have changed the terms on the subscriber. now I will have to pay more to go ad free. so the first subscription was for the content and the second was to go ad free. it started with prime video and is continued with prime music. they are pushing people to unsubscribe so they got their wish. unsubscribing to all amazon services. this is unfair trade practices and I forgot one won't stand for it

It cannot do the one fundamental thing a music player app needs to be able to -- reliably play back music without stopping. If the app is playing, and you put the phone down and just want to listen - it will eventually just pause/stop. Going back into the app sometimes makes it restart by itself, sometimes you need to hit play again. Seriously - this is the most infuriating app I have ever dealt with. And yes, I have tried every battery optimisation setting in Android. Nothing helps.

It bogs down frequently, and saved/Playlist songs come and go, but they've got nearly everything you could want to hear (even removed songs can be found on different albums), and resolution is often updated. Not perfect, but great. UPDATE: three stars Now they have podcasts, very good, but they keep demanding permission to use Bluetooth devices. No, amazon, you don't need to listen in on me when I'm doing the dishes and taking a shower...2026 update crashes WAY too often. Took off a star.

I like it but it has flaws. The latest update made the auto play feature not work any longer even though it is selected on. Edit 6/7/26 auto play works. But this app is extremely slow a lot of the time, and has become unresponsive to changing songs, selecting playlists. I very often have to force close the app and clear cache and data, and restart it. frustrating.

Amazon tech admitted problems with interface between music app and Echo devices. AMAZON IS NOT TRYING TO FIX IT. I'VE BEEN COMPLAINING FOR 5 YEARS. It is definitely an Amazon Music app problem and it is getting worse every time they update the app or add more features. Alexa 2.0 is dreadful. Alexa is worse at understanding commands, finding songs, the app makes editing playlists so difficult I want to pull my hair out.

It is quite buggy on Vivo X300 and often doesn't respond to tws touch controls while other apps like Youtube music and spotify work just fine. I have turned the video playback off from settings but whenever I start playing a song a "HD video available" toast pops up over seek button which is quite annoying and there's no way to turn that off. I cannot recommend spending money on this app at all.

I've been using the pro version since the launch of jiosaavan( music) . They could do better by adding more caller tunes, and selecting the music part on our own, still some songs are missing, and the features like sleep timer doesn't work

I have used Jiosaavn many times and uninstalled it for the same reason. No matter which song you play, after the song is over, it returns to the same set of songs irrespective of the mood / genre of the song you played at first. It does nit play similar songs as per your mood, though I have checked autoplay option. This problem still remains as is. Not returning to Jiosaavn again...

worst possible algorithm, I wish I knew this before buying the premium. there's absolutely no correlation between two songs in a queue, they are playing whatever is famously being played at the moment. on top of that they don't even have mainstream songs available, it's like a cherry on top. ABSOLUTE TRASH.

why does my liked playlist show 434 songs on the app but on PC it's about 495+? weird. still won't let me restart a song at the end of a queue properly anymore, some songs start halfway through/near the end for no reason after loading, and most have a hiccup in the first 10 seconds when i start a new playlist or repeat a song (update, the hiccups are now MID SONG AS WELL) the UI is clunky & curated mixes don't refresh frequently enough.

Update: this issue has come back with a vengeance. I'm giving up on Soundcloud and moving to Mixcloud. Do you really need to either insist that we pay or blast us with the same intrusive adverts again and again? I gave up after the app basically demanded that I watch (not listen to, watch) the same Uber Eats advert again and again. Adverts play literally every 3 tracks, even if you only listen to 5 seconds before skipping to the next track. Do better, or lose users, Soundcloud.

I am not able to use this app while connected to any Bluetooth device. It comes across as choppy and I am not able to listen to a full song without it sounding like my devices are 50 feet away from my phone. It's not an issue with any other audio app, solely something that seems to affect SoundCloud. I love SoundCloud, and have been using it for over a decade now. I love using it for finding new music and getting to know artists who are not so well-known. I will rate higher once it's fixed.

Before, SoundCloud would randomly pause for a second then start up again (for *every* *single* song). It was annoying, but manageable. The new update completely broke the app. Now, if I accidentally swipe past a song and try to swipe back, the song sits frozen for 3 minutes, then says "Not Playable", even though I was just listening to it. I can trace this issue to the new update because it literally didn't start until I updated my app. Today. This app is slowly degrading and that makes me sad.

I've a Spotify user for years, but there's so many issues! First of all, for nearly 1.5 years my app has been randomly crashing with no crash report. Second of all, the song DNA feature barely works and is very annoying to use. Third, since when did clicking on an artist's name under a song title make me do an EXTRA click to get to either one? Infuriating! Fourth, please move the "new releases" tab back where it was. Lastly, ADD AN OPTION TO DISABLE AI. Stop showing AI and fix these issues!

Homescreen is an ADHD nightmare, it's filled with algorithm garbage you can't get rid of. Spotify is pretty good. There are a LOT of problems though. There is no option to show all songs by an artist, you have to look up the song specifically or just know the album it's on, then find that album. Can't filter by release date. Can't remove recommendations I don't have any interest in. Spotify absolutely destroys my battery. Let me customize MY home screen!

The free version is complete trash now -can't skip without ads, can't play albums in order, constant popups for premium, and they have even stopped you from playing your "liked" songs. I mean, how could you stop us from playing our favorite song. So what's the point of this app again? It's better to listen to the radio, at least they play the latest songs. The app is total trash now. I'm planning to switch. Let's see what we can find. Constant popups for premium, can't skip without long ads,

It was good but now there are too many ads. Like it's understandable that we aren't using premium, but the ad is too much. Right after opening and trying to play a song, I need to listen to two-30 seconds ads and then after listening to just one or two songs there is a long back to back ads. I won't mind some ads but the current rate is too much!

1•Too many ads too often. Music listening not consistent enough. 2• Ongoing issue, Artists on Spotify getting hacked and their music stolen by hackers & bots. Poor moderation, if there was human oversight it would be fixed. It's not hard for a human to identify. And please ban "Soft Avenue" for stealing Soddiken's hit, "Misery Meat". Hacked Spotify pages are posting AI generated songs & albums that the real artists did not create. I can't imagine how many smaller artists are experiencing this.

I had rated this app with 4 stars but I've recently noticed it letting in AI generated music under the names of bands which I like, though they are clearly not them. This damages the band, cheats users, and weakens the app. Devs--if it's slipping past YT somehow please place the power to audit this with the fans, real human PAYING listeners who can catch this junk and help knock it out. A simple "This song/album is AI" option in the menu will clear out this slop and get you back in our graces.

I'm having difficulty altering the song order on my playlists. Despite the app claiming that it successfully updated the playlist, the newly added songs are not in the order I intended when I reopen the playlist each time. I'm forced to remove and re-add songs one by one. (It's not an issue with the song queue, which is a minor blessing.) What's worse is that whenever my device undergoes a system update, my playlists are emptied and I have to rebuild them from scratch! It's so tedious!
